description: GridFM GraphKit is the GridFM team's Python toolset for training, fine-tuning and evaluating neural models of steady-state electrical networks. YAML configurations control datasets and models, while command-line operations produce saved model states, MLflow experiment records and Parquet predictions at buses and branches. Optional outputs include learned embeddings and electrical constraint metrics. Spatial coverage follows the supplied grid; each sample represents an operating state, not a fixed geographic or historical series. Source is free under Apache-2.0. A limitation is that configuration versions and training normalisation statistics must be preserved for reproducible inference. The torch-scatter dependency needs a compatible separate installation. GraphKit can support power-flow surrogate experiments and simulation comparisons with physical solvers such as OpenDSS (platform-opendss). The repository cites the GENCO development paper and distinguishes its separate data-generation companion. No trained weights or grid dataset was downloaded.
name: GridFM GraphKit
